findings.title: Stale comment no longer matches cached presence check
findings.detail: The comment says obid asks `security` for "whether the item exists, each time", but after this change `cursor_keychain_has` now caches a positive existence result for `LOOK_EVERY` (2s), so with the three `GET /v1/status` calls issued back-to-back in this test, the presence check (`-s cursor-access-token`/`cursor-api-key` without `-w`) is very likely only asked once too, not every time. The test's `read()` helper only counts `-w` (value) reads so it doesn't fail, but the comment is now inaccurate documentation of the behaviour this diff introduces.
